# id_01_lo_05

## Corriger données d'identité

```{r M5_A0 to M5_A2}

# Ajouter id_doublon
M5_A1 <- M5_A0 %>%
  left_join(
    M1_A3 %>% 
      select(id_anonymat:id_keep),
    by = "id_anonymat"
  ) %>% 
  relocate(id_doublon:id_keep, .after = id_anonymat) %>% 
  select(-id_sep, -id_type, -tab_db) %>% 
  haven::zap_label() %>% 
  haven::zap_formats() %>% 
  mutate(across(
    .cols = where(is.character),
    .fns = ~ na_if(., "")
  )) %>% 
  mutate(
    id_prenom = replace_when(
      id_prenom,
      id_prenom == "NA" ~ "NAA"
    )
  )

# Remplir les données manquantes de l'identité

M5_A2 <- M5_A1 %>% 
  rows_patch(
    M1_A3 %>% 
      select(any_of(colnames(M5_A1))),
    by = "id_anonymat",
    unmatched = "ignore"
  ) %>% 
  select(-(lo_type:id_age_cat_3))

```

## Travailler sur les colonnes
### Renommer et réordonner

```{r M5_A2 to M5_B0}

vars_sub_la <- M5_A2 %>% 
  select(all_of(starts_with("la_"))) %>% 
  colnames()

M5_B0 <- M5_A2 %>% 
  rename_with(~ gsub("^la_", "lo_", .x), all_of(vars_sub_la)) %>% 
  rename("lo_commentaires" = "commentaires_loge",
         "lo_dep_centre1" = "dep_centre1",
         "lo_statut_occup" = "lo_occup_logement",
         "lo_statut_occup_autre" = "lo_occup_logement_autre",
         "lo_dep_situ_centre1" = "dep_la_situ_centre1") %>% 
  relocate(c("lo_date_creation", "lo_an_logement",
             "lo_situ_logement", "lo_situ_dep", "lo_dep_situ_centre1", "lo_situ_pays"),
           .after = id_age) %>% 
  relocate(lo_dep_situ_centre1, .after = lo_dep_centre1) %>%
  relocate(c("lo_type_logement", "lo_type_logement_autre", "lo_statut_occup",
             "lo_statut_occup_autre", "lo_occup_cause_1", "lo_occup_cause_2",
             "lo_occup_cause_3", "lo_occup_cause_999", "lo_occup_cause_autre",
             "lo_amenag_logement", "lo_amenag_logement_precis", "lo_emprunt_1",
             "lo_emprunt_2", "lo_emprunt_3", "lo_emprunt_4", "lo_emprunt_5",
             "lo_emprunt_6", "lo_emprunt_precis", "lo_demenag", "lo_demenag_cause_1",
             "lo_demenag_cause_2", "lo_demenag_cause_999", "lo_demenag_cause_autre"),
           .after = lo_dep_situ_centre1) %>% 
  relocate(lo_commentaires, .after = last_col()) %>% 
  select(-fa_amenag) %>% 
  relocate(id_doublon:id_age, .after = last_col())

rm(vars_sub_la)
```

### Identifier absents

```{r M5_B0 to M5_B1}

vars_check <- M5_B0 %>%
  select(lo_an_logement:lo_situ_pays, lo_type_logement:lo_demenag_cause_autre) %>%
  names()

M5_B1 <- M5_B0 %>%
  mutate(
    absent = if_all(all_of(vars_check), is.na),
    .after = id_anonymat
  ) %>% 
  
  # Identifier ceux qui ont participé au module
  mutate(
    lo_complet = case_when(
      absent ~ 0L,
      !absent ~ 1L,
      TRUE ~ -99L
    ),
    .after = id_anonymat
  ) %>% 
  select(-absent) %>% 
  
  # Ajouter petit changement unique
  mutate(
    lo_dep_centre1 = replace_when(
      lo_dep_centre1,
      id_anonymat == "WUJIE" ~ -8L
    )
  )

```

## Travailler sur les lignes

### Retirer les doublons

```{r M5_B1 to M5_C0}

# Identifier les doublons
doublons <- M5_B1 %>% 
  group_by(id_keep) %>% 
  filter(n() > 1) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  relocate(c("id_doublon", "id_keep"), .after = id_anonymat)

# Corriger les données d'identité issues du questionnaire

doublons_corr <- doublons %>% 
  fill(lo_dep_centre1:lo_dep_situ_centre1, .direction = "up") %>% 
  mutate(
    id_anonymat = id_keep
  ) %>% 
  filter(lo_complet == 1)

# Joindre les données propres
M5_C0 <- M5_B1 %>% 
  filter_out(id_keep %in% doublons$id_keep) %>% 
  bind_rows(doublons_corr) %>% 
  arrange(id_anonymat)

```

# Corriger NAs M5_C0

```{r}

M5_C0 <- readr::read_csv("data_hors_git/process_data/thoa_M5_C0.csv",
                         show_col_types = F)

```

## NAs uniques

```{r M5_C0 to M5_D0}

M5_D0 <- M5_C0 %>% 
  mutate(
    
    # lo_situ_pays est particulier parce qu'une modalité ne figure que si la
    # personne a déclaré vivre à l'étranger. Donc le recodage doit se faire à
    # la main puisqu'elle se comporte de manière unique.
    lo_situ_pays = case_when(
      !is.na(lo_situ_pays) ~ lo_situ_pays,
      is.na(lo_situ_pays) & !is.na(lo_situ_dep) ~ 1,
      is.na(lo_situ_pays) & lo_complet == 0 ~ -2,
      is.na(lo_situ_pays) & is.na(lo_situ_dep) & lo_complet == 1 ~ -9,
      TRUE ~ 999
    ),
    
    # Ici on applique -9 parce que c'est pour toutes les personnes qui n'ont pas
    # renseigné un premier centre de suivi. On ignore donc le departement.
    lo_dep_centre1 = replace_when(
      lo_dep_centre1,
      is.na(lo_dep_centre1) ~ -9
    ),
    
    lo_situ_dep = case_when(
      !is.na(lo_situ_dep) ~ lo_situ_dep,
      is.na(lo_situ_dep) & lo_complet == 0 ~ -2,
      is.na(lo_situ_dep) & lo_situ_logement == 2 ~ -1,
      is.na(lo_situ_dep) & lo_complet == 1 ~ -9,
      TRUE ~ -999
    ),
    
    # Ici on remplace à la main, parce que la donnée est aussi unique.
    lo_situation_cor = case_when(
      lo_situ_dep == -9 & lo_dep_centre1 == -9 ~ "-9",
      lo_situ_dep == lo_dep_centre1 ~ "Meme departement",
      lo_dep_centre1 == -9 & lo_complet == 0 ~ "-2",
      lo_dep_centre1 == -9 & lo_complet == 1 ~ "-9",
      lo_complet == 0 ~ "-2",
      lo_situ_dep == -9 ~ "-9",
      lo_situ_dep != lo_dep_centre1 ~ "Departement different",
      TRUE ~ "-999"
    )
  ) %>% 
  relocate(lo_situation_cor, .after = lo_dep_situ_centre1) %>% 
  select(-lo_dep_situ_centre1)
```

## NAs simples

```{r fonction_simple}

rcd_simple_1 <- function(df, vars, complet){
  df %>% 
    mutate(
      across(
        {{vars}},
        ~ (case_when(
          !is.na(.) ~ .,
          is.na(.) & {{complet}} == 1 ~ -9,
          is.na(.) & {{complet}} == 0 ~ -2,
          TRUE ~ -999
        ))
      )
    )
}

```

```{r M5_D0 to M5_D1}

vars_simples <- M5_D0 %>% 
  select(lo_an_logement, lo_situ_logement, lo_type_logement:lo_demenag,
         -ends_with("_autre"), -contains("occup_cause_"),
         -contains("emprunt"), -contains("demenag_cause_"), 
         -contains("precis")) %>% 
  names()

M5_D1 <- M5_D0 %>% 
  rcd_simple_1(all_of(vars_simples), lo_complet)

```

## NAs QCM

```{r fonctions_qcm}

rcd_qcm_simple <- function(df, vars, complet){
  df %>%
    mutate(
      all_na_vars = if_all({{vars}}, is.na)
    ) %>% 
    mutate(
      across(
        {{vars}},
        ~ (case_when(
          !is.na(.) ~ .,
          {{complet}} == 0 ~ -2,
          {{complet}} == 1 & all_na_vars ~ -9,
          {{complet}} == 1 & is.na(.x) ~ 0,
          TRUE ~ -999                           
        ))
      )
    ) %>%
    select(-all_na_vars)
}

rcd_qcm_borne <- function(df, borne, vars, complet){
  df %>%
    mutate(
      all_na_vars = if_all({{vars}}, is.na)
    ) %>% 
    mutate(
      across(
        {{vars}},
        ~ (case_when(
          !is.na(.) ~ .,
          {{borne}} == -2 ~ -2,
          {{borne}} == 0 & all_na_vars ~ -1,
          {{borne}} == 1 & all_na_vars ~ -9,
          {{borne}} == -9 & all_na_vars ~ -9,
          {{borne}} == 1 & is.na(.x) ~ 0,
          TRUE ~ -999                           
        ))
      )
    ) %>%
    select(-all_na_vars)
}

```

```{r M5_D1 to M5_D2}
vars_L5 <- M5_D1 %>% 
  select(lo_occup_cause_1:lo_occup_cause_999) %>% 
  names()

vars_L8 <- M5_D1 %>% 
  select(lo_emprunt_1:lo_emprunt_6) %>% 
  names()

vars_L11 <- M5_D1 %>% 
  select(lo_demenag_cause_1:lo_demenag_cause_999) %>% 
  names()

M5_D2 <- M5_D1 %>% 
  rcd_qcm_simple(all_of(vars_L5), lo_complet) %>% 
  rcd_qcm_simple(all_of(vars_L8), lo_complet) %>% 
  
  # Il y a deux personnes qui ont dit ne pas vouloir déménager, mais ont quand
  # meme répondu à la question suivante et ont donné la raison de leur désire
  # de déménager donc j'ai changé leur réponse pour mettre oui.
  mutate(
    lo_demenag = replace_when(
      lo_demenag,
      lo_demenag == 0 & lo_demenag_cause_999 == 1 ~ 1
    )
  ) %>% 
  rcd_qcm_borne(lo_demenag, all_of(vars_L11), lo_complet)

# rm(list = c("vars_simples", "vars_L8", "vars_L5", "vars_L11"))

```

## NAs texte

```{r}

rcd_texte_autre <- function(df, borne, reponse){
  df %>% 
    mutate(
      {{reponse}} := case_when(
        !is.na({{reponse}}) ~ {{reponse}},
        {{borne}} == 999 & is.na({{reponse}}) ~ "-9",
        {{borne}} == -2 & is.na({{reponse}}) ~ "-2",
        {{borne}} == -9 & is.na({{reponse}}) ~ "-9",
        {{borne}} == -1 & is.na({{reponse}}) ~ "-1",
        {{borne}} >= 0 & {{borne}} <= 90 & is.na({{reponse}}) ~ "-1",
        TRUE ~ "-999"
      )
    )
}

rcd_texte_borne1 <- function(df, borne, reponse){
  df %>% 
    mutate(
      {{reponse}} := case_when(
        !is.na({{reponse}}) ~ {{reponse}},
        ({{borne}} == 1 | {{borne}} == 2) & is.na({{reponse}}) ~ "-9",
        {{borne}} == 0 & is.na({{reponse}}) ~ "-1",
        {{borne}} == -2 & is.na({{reponse}}) ~ "-2",
        {{borne}} == -9 & is.na({{reponse}}) ~ "-9",
        {{borne}} == -1 & is.na({{reponse}}) ~ "-1",
        TRUE ~ "-999"
      )
    )
}

rcd_texte_qcm <- function(df, borne, reponse){
  df %>% 
    mutate(
      {{reponse}} := case_when(
        !is.na({{reponse}}) ~ {{reponse}},
        {{borne}} == 1 & is.na({{reponse}}) ~ "-9",
        {{borne}} == 0 & is.na({{reponse}}) ~ "-1",
        {{borne}} == -2 & is.na({{reponse}}) ~ "-2",
        {{borne}} == -9 & is.na({{reponse}}) ~ "-9",
        {{borne}} == -1 & is.na({{reponse}}) ~ "-1",
        TRUE ~ "-999"
      )
    )
}


```

## Traduire réponses libres
Y revenir à 17h20
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)


# 2. Valeurs uniques, non vides, sur les 6 variables à la fois
textes_uniques <- M5_D4 %>%
  select(all_of(vars_libres)) %>%
  unlist(use.names = FALSE) %>%
  unique() %>%
  discard(~ is.na(.x) || trimws(.x) == "")

fichier_dico <- "dico_traduction.rds"

# Reprend là où on s'était arrêté, si une sauvegarde existe
dico <- if (file.exists(fichier_dico)) readRDS(fichier_dico) else character(0)

traduire <- function(x, essais = 5) {
  for (i in seq_len(essais)) {
    res <- tryCatch(
      google_translate(x, target_language = "en",
                                 source_language = "fr"),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
    if (length(res) == 1 && !is.na(res)) return(res)
    attente <- 10 * 2^(i - 1)  # 10 s, 20 s, 40 s, 80 s, 160 s
    message("Échec, nouvel essai dans ", attente, " s...")
    Sys.sleep(attente)
  }
  NA_character_
}

a_traduire <- setdiff(textes_uniques, names(dico))

for (i in seq_along(a_traduire)) {
  txt <- a_traduire[i]
  dico[txt] <- traduire(txt)
  Sys.sleep(1)  # pause entre chaque requête
  if (i %% 20 == 0) {
    saveRDS(dico, fichier_dico)
    message(i, " / ", length(a_traduire), " traduits")
  }
}
saveRDS(dico, fichier_dico)

# 4. Application aux 6 colonnes
M5_D5 <- M5_D4 %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(vars_libres),
                ~ unname(dico[.x]),
                .names = "{.col}_en"))

for (v in vars_libres) {
  M5_D5 <- relocate(M5_D5, all_of(paste0(v, "_en")), .after = all_of(v))
}

readr::write_csv(M5_D5, "/Users/alicethomassin/Muco 2026/data_hors_git/process_data/thoa_M5_D5_eng.csv")
```

## Traduire commentaires


```{r}
library(polyglotr)
library(purrr)

M5_E2 <- M5_E1 %>% 
  mutate(
    lo_commentaires_en = map_chr(
      lo_commentaires,
      ~ if (is.na(.x) || .x == "") {
          NA_character_
        } else {
          google_translate(
            .x,
            target_language = "en",
            source_language = "fr"
          )
        }
    ),
    .after = lo_commentaires
  )


```

# META DATA

```{r}
M5_E3 <- haven::read_dta("/Users/alicethomassin/Muco 2026/data_hors_git/Peter/thoa5_Housing_454.dta")

dico_ho <- generate_dictionary(M5_E3) %>% 
  convert_list_columns_to_character() %>% 
  select(variable, label, col_type, value_labels) %>% 
  mutate(
    origin = if_else(str_detect(label, "^[A-Z]+\\d+ "), "question", "derived"),
    ref = if_else(col_type != "chr", str_extract(label, "^[A-Z]+\\d+"), paste0(str_extract(label, "^[A-Z]+\\d+"), "_txt"))
  ) %>% 
    relocate(ref, .after = variable) %>% 
    group_by(ref, col_type) %>% 
    mutate(
      ref = replace_when(
        ref,
        str_detect(label, "(MR)") ~ paste0(ref, "_", row_number()),
        ref == "L02" ~ paste0(ref, "_", row_number())
      )
    ) %>% 
      ungroup()
```


```{r}
housing <- readr::read_csv("data_hors_git/meta_questions/housing.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

meta_ho <- housing %>% 
  mutate(
    ref = str_replace_all(variable, "-", "0"),
    ref = str_replace_all(ref, "_([:alpha:]+)([^txt])", ""),
    ref = str_replace_all(ref, "0(?=\\d{2,})", ""),
    ref = if_else(ref == "L09", "L09_txt", ref),
    .before = variable
  ) %>% 
    filter_out(
      variable == "L-2"
    ) %>% 
      group_by(ref) %>% 
      mutate(
        ref = if_else(ref == "L02", paste0(ref, "_", row_number()), ref)
      ) %>% 
        ungroup() %>% 
    select(-variable) %>% 
  left_join(
    dico_ho %>% select(variable, ref),
    by = "ref",
    relationship = "many-to-many"
  ) %>% 
    relocate(variable) %>% 
    filter(!is.na(variable)) %>% 
    mutate(
      notes_fr = NA_character_,
      notes_en = NA_character_
    )
```
